desc:
🥚 Welcome to Open Chest for Eggs!

How to Play:
🗝️ Open chests in different zones!
🥚 Steal eggs from chests!
🐾 Steal other players' pets from their pens!
💰 Earn money from your pets!
🏃 Train your speed and upgrade your treadmill!
🏠 Upgrade your base for longer pen protection!
✨ Discover rare pets and build the ultimate pet collection!

🎮 Supports PC, Mobile, and Tablet players!

Have fun and happy collecting! 🥚
